# cubepath_lb_target (Resource)

Manages a backend of a load balancer listener: a VPS, a baremetal server or a whole availability group. Import with loadbalancer_id/listener_id/target_id (the target row UUID).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `listener_id` (String) UUID of the listener. Changing it forces a new target.
- `loadbalancer_id` (String) UUID of the load balancer. Changing it forces a new target.
- `target_id` (String) ID of the VPS or baremetal server, or UUID of the availability group. Changing it forces a new target.
- `target_type` (String) Backend type: vps, baremetal or availability_group. Changing it forces a new target.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the load balancer sends traffic to this target. Defaults to true.
- `port` (Number) Port on the backend. Omit it to use the listener's target_port (removing it replaces the target).
- `weight` (Number) Weight, 1 to 100. Defaults to 100.

### Read-Only

- `health_status` (String) Health reported by the load balancer: healthy, unhealthy, draining or unknown.
- `id` (String) UUID of the target.
- `target_name` (String) Name of the backend.
